name: tl;dv
tagline: tl;dv (too long; didn't view) records, transcribes, and summarises meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Its AI automatically identifies key moments, action items, and decisions, creating a searchable archive of everything discussed. Sales teams use it to review calls and coach reps, while product teams use it to capture customer interviews. Its clip-sharing feature lets anyone share the exact moment from a meeting that matters, eliminating the need to watch full recordings.
